## Goals of this code:

1.  Read in 8100 files - with chamber ID, start time, end time, V1-V4
2.  Separate 8100 file into each flux
3.  Extract metadata from each flux file into a metadata sheet

**Need to figure out how to incorporate the 8100 error log 
(remove those fluxes?)**

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(R.utils)
library(rprojroot)
library(googledrive)
```

## Download zipped 81x files into temporary data folder

```{r download-8100}
options(googledrive_quiet = TRUE)

# Find temporary data directory
ROOT <- find_root(has_file_pattern("Rproj$"))
tmp_dir <- file.path(ROOT, "temp_data/")

GDRIVE_8100_FOLDER <- "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/107du2DkwDA2VpeqxdegbSe_dCoVvgpmP"

# Filter to necessary files
files_pulse <- drive_ls(path = GDRIVE_8100_FOLDER,
                        recursive = TRUE,
                        pattern = "81x$")

download_files <- function(files_pulse) {
    # Download files to local directory
    invisible(
        lapply(seq_len(nrow(files_pulse)), function(i) {
            outfile <- file.path(tmp_dir, files_pulse$name[i])
            if(file.exists(outfile)) {
                message("Skipped existing file ", basename(outfile))
            }
            drive_download(
                file = as_id(files_pulse$id[i]),
                path = outfile,
                overwrite = TRUE
            )
        })
    )   
}

download_files(files_pulse)

# List extracted 8100 files (full paths)
file.list.8100 <- list.files(path = tmp_dir,
                             pattern = "81x$",
                             full.names = TRUE)

message("We have ", length(file.list.8100), " files")
```

## Download 7810 data files

```{r download-7810}
GDRIVE_7810_FOLDER <- "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12vQiSxn6l4wgJ5tpSI2TNHl7k6Jkx77s"

# Filter to necessary files
files_pulse <- drive_ls(
  path = GDRIVE_7810_FOLDER,
  recursive = TRUE,
  pattern = "TG10.*data$")

download_files(files_pulse)

# 7810 files (full paths)
file.list.7810 <- list.files(path = tmp_dir,
                        pattern = "TG10.*data$")

message("We have ", length(file.list.7810), " files")
```

## Split 8100 files into one-per-observation files

```{r split-8100-files}
# Split files into multiple files, one for each chamber run, 
# and save in temporary directory 

file_counter <- 1
for (f in file.list.8100) { 
    bnf <- basename(f)
    message("Reading ", bnf, "... ", appendLF = FALSE)
    lines <- readLines(f)
    
    # Find all the lines that start with LI-8100 in this file
    l8100 <- grep("^LI-8100", lines)
    # Add one at end so that 'last' calculation below works for final entry
    l8100 <- c(l8100, length(lines) + 1) 
    
    for(i in seq_along(head(l8100, -1))) {
       output_name <- paste0(gsub(".81x", "", bnf, fixed = TRUE),
                             "_", i, ".txt")
       first <- l8100[i]
       last <- l8100[i+1] - 1
       #message("Writing ", output_name, " (", basename(f), " lines ", first, "-", last, ")")
       writeLines(lines[first:last], file.path(tmp_dir, output_name)) 
       file_counter <- file_counter + 1
    }
    if(is.null(i)) {
        message("NO DATA FOUND")
    } else {
        message("wrote ", i, " split files")
    }
} # for f
```

## Extract metadata from JSONs

```{r extract-metadata}
# List extracted JSON files (full paths)
split.file.list <- list.files(
    path = tmp_dir,
    pattern = "txt$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    recursive = TRUE
)

ffi_read_LI78x0 <- function(file, model) {
    #message("Reading ", basename(file))
    dat_raw <- readLines(file)
    
    # Make sure this is the desired model
    file_model <- substr(dat_raw[1], 1, 7)
    if(file_model != model) stop("This does not appear to be a ", model, " file!")
    
    # Save the observation number
    obs <- trimws(gsub("Obs#:\t", "", dat_raw[7], fixed = TRUE))
    # Save the observation length
    obs_length <- trimws(gsub("Observation Length:\t", "", dat_raw[10], fixed = TRUE))
    # Save the machine serial number
    sn <- trimws(gsub("Serial Number:\t", "", dat_raw[4], fixed = TRUE))
    # Parse the collar label from the header
    label <- trimws(gsub("Label:\t", "", dat_raw[9], fixed = TRUE))
    # Parse the collar number from the header
    chamber <- trimws(gsub("Chamber:\t", "", dat_raw[14], fixed = TRUE))
    # Parse the chamber volume from the header
    Vtotal <- trimws(gsub("Vtotal:\t", "", dat_raw[25], fixed = TRUE))
    # Parse the dead band from the footer
    DeadBand <- trimws(gsub("Dead Band:\t", "", dat_raw[length(dat_raw)-2], fixed = TRUE))
    # Parse the closing time from the header and use it to make a collar field
    TimeClosing <- trimws(gsub("TimeClosing:\t", "", dat_raw[length(dat_raw)-1], fixed = TRUE))
    
    # These files have 30 header lines, the column names in line 31,
    # and then the column units in line 7. We only want the names and then data
    total_lines = countLines(file)
    lines_to_skip <- 30
    lines_to_read <- total_lines - 30 - 25
    
    dat_read <- read.delim(
        file = file,
        skip = lines_to_skip,
        nrows = lines_to_read,
        sep = "\t",
        header = TRUE)
    
    # Get first and last timestamp
    start_time <- first(dat_read$Date)
    end_time <- last(dat_read$Date)
    
    # Get average of environmental variables (V1-V4)
    Tcham <- mean(dat_read$Tcham, na.rm = TRUE)
    Pressure <- mean(dat_read$Pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
    V1_avg <- mean(dat_read$V1, na.rm = TRUE)
    V2_avg <- mean(dat_read$V2, na.rm = TRUE)
    V3_avg <- mean(dat_read$V3, na.rm = TRUE)
    V4_avg <- mean(dat_read$V4, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Return assembled data
    tibble(SN = sn,
           label = label,
           chamber = chamber, 
           Vtotal = Vtotal, 
           obs_length = obs_length, 
           DeadBand = DeadBand, 
           TimeClosing = TimeClosing, 
           start_time = start_time, 
           end_time = end_time,
           Tcham = Tcham, 
           Pressure = Pressure, 
           V1_avg = V1_avg,
           V2_avg = V2_avg,
           V3_avg = V3_avg,
           V4_avg = V4_avg,
           file = basename(file))
}

ffi_read_LI8100 <- function(file) {
    ffi_read_LI78x0(file, "LI-8100")
}

# Don't process any files that don't have the LI-800 and were just cut at the end 
split.file.list <- split.file.list[sapply(split.file.list, function(f) {
    x <- readLines(f, n = 20, warn = FALSE)
    first <- x[nzchar(x)][1]
    
    !is.na(first) && grepl("^LI-8100", first)
})]

# Process all files and combine into a single data frame 
message("Processing ", length(split.file.list), " split files...")
lapply(split.file.list, ffi_read_LI8100) |> 
    bind_rows() ->
    alldat

message("alldat is ", nrow(alldat), " x ", ncol(alldat))
```

## Join with collar metadata

```{r collar-map}
message("Reading collar map...")
collar_metadata <- read_csv(file.path(ROOT, "metadata", "collar_map.csv"),
                            col_types = "ccic_")

alldat %>% 
    left_join(collar_metadata, 
              by = c("label" = "Collar"),
              relationship = "many-to-one") ->
    alldat_collars

### Probably need to do some cleaning here on the temperature data 
message("alldat_collars is ", nrow(alldat_collars), " x ", ncol(alldat_collars))
```

## Write out parsed 8100 metadata

```{r output}
outfile <- file.path("Processed_Data",
                     "COMPASS_TEMPESTX_SoilFluxes_8100_Metadata_processed.csv")
message("Writing ", outfile)
#export as a csv to the folder that you want 
write_csv(alldat_collars, outfile)
```
